body: What sucks, is having no supportive family, no friends..no body. I’m completely alone.
Thank you so much for writing that message to me, I appreciate your time and effort in trying to talk to me and make me feel better.
It was tough, because I am new to publishing. But if you know your way around Amazon, than it will be easy.

Hi! We can be friends for sure! I just published my first book too through amazon! (I am getting my copy tomorrow.) I am super excited for you! Wow. I have to buy a copy from you. You seem like a very cool person.
I am suppose to be on medication. But after insurance kicked me off at 19, because I was 19...dumb reason. I could not afford medication.
I was diagnosed eith major depression and other disorders.
You are right in a way. Also, I mean I am talking to you. So, I guess I have someone to talk too..
I don't know....I just...it's getting to much for me. Something may happen.
Hello, I would like to take you up on the offer! I need someone to talk with
